clips.title: 中国人民银行副行长陈德霖：中国经济转型创新，科技驱动长期增长
title_lines: 中国人民银行副行长陈

subtitles.en: China as a central driver for the global economy, China's mainland economy is also a supporting foundation for Hong Kong's development.
subtitles.zh: 中国作为全球经济核心引擎，内地经济也是香港发展的支撑基础。

subtitles.en: Two weeks ago, Premier Li Qian, speech at the summit, that the stability of China's development is depending on two factors, first, the stable environment, second, the new channels, technology innovation is the long-term strategy for China's development.
subtitles.zh: 两周前，李强总理在峰会上表示，中国发展稳定取决于两个因素：稳定环境和科技创新，这是长期战略。

subtitles.en: China has the huge market and the complete value chain and high-speed development of technology and the large pool of talents. China's company are investing a lot in R&D and helping the integration of research with industry.
subtitles.zh: 中国拥有巨大市场、完整价值链、高速发展的科技和庞大人才库。企业大力投入研发，促进产学研融合。

subtitles.en: Our growth model shifted from the production elements to innovation and from manufacturing to high-tech development and emerging technologies. This sustainable development of technology offers us resilience and long-term growth.
subtitles.zh: 增长模式从要素驱动转向创新驱动，从制造转向高科技和新兴技术。科技的可持续发展带来韧性和长期增长。
en_highlights: shifted from production elements to innovation

subtitles.en: Starting from this year, China will focus on more high-tech development through the master plan and the mid-term check and the end-term targets and China is trying to ensure the high-quality development.
subtitles.zh: 从今年起，中国将通过总体规划、中期检查和期末目标聚焦高科技发展，确保高质量增长。

subtitles.en: The macro policy as the stability, the monetary policy turns to be supportive, the financial policy is beneficiary to the industry development. The Chinese financial market and internationalization of R&B are ongoing.
subtitles.zh: 宏观政策保持稳定，货币政策转向支持，金融政策利好产业发展。中国金融市场和人民币国际化持续推进。
en_highlights: monetary policy turns to be supportive

subtitles.en: It is an opportunity for Hong Kong as the international currency system is going to be diversified and the speed is getting faster. The demand for R&B is growth from the settlement to financing and reserve and pricing.
subtitles.zh: 国际货币体系多元化加速，香港迎来机遇。人民币需求从结算扩展到融资、储备和定价。

subtitles.en: Hong Kong as the window and the trail area for opening up to the world, Hong Kong attracts enterprises from the overseas market, invest in the mainland market and Hong Kong's attractiveness in this regard will only go higher.
subtitles.zh: 香港作为对外开放的窗口和试验田，吸引海外企业投资内地市场，其吸引力将持续提升。

subtitles.en: President Xi speaks at the 25th anniversary of Hong Kong's return to the motherland and addresses the determination to ensure Hong Kong's stability and build Hong Kong as the hub in many industries and safeguard the openness and freedom in Hong Kong and also the enabling environment for business.
subtitles.zh: 习近平主席在香港回归25周年讲话中，决心确保香港稳定，打造多行业枢纽，维护开放自由和营商环境。

subtitles.en: PBOC will work closer to the SAO government and other authorities to work in four regards and consolidate Hong Kong's strength in finance and open up more areas of development. Connection scheme will help the development of the financial market.
subtitles.zh: 人民银行将与香港金管局等部门密切合作，从四方面巩固香港金融优势，拓展发展空间。互联互通将助力金融市场发展。

subtitles.en: Financial market is the essential part of Hong Kong's hub, Hong Kong's hub row as the financial market and a lot of the companies joining this market from the mainland in Hong Kong will support the high-quality enterprises to get listed in Hong Kong and explore more connections scheme, on bond, interest, swap and wealth management. And we will also integrate the financial management system of the Great Bay Area.
subtitles.zh: 金融市场是香港枢纽的核心，大量内地企业来港上市，支持优质企业上市并拓展债券、利率互换、理财等互联互通。还将整合大湾区金融管理体系。

subtitles.en: Source and bond size of the bond connect scheme will be enlarged from 500 billion to 800 billion and source bond will be included in the buy-byte supportive scheme and the coverage will include the RMB and Hong Kong dollar related products. Also, Markle Market will be included.
subtitles.zh: 债券通南向通额度从5000亿增至8000亿，并纳入人民币和港币相关产品，货币市场也将纳入。

subtitles.en: Last year, I mentioned that the foreign reserve of the PBOC will have more presence in Hong Kong. In the past one year, the foreign reserve is active in investing in Hong Kong. In the future, the foreign reserve will have more allocation in the Hong Kong market that will give a vitality to the Hong Kong's development.
subtitles.zh: 去年我提到外汇储备将更多配置香港。过去一年已积极投资，未来将加大配置，为香港发展注入活力。

subtitles.en: Secondly, to support Hong Kong's diversified financial market, financial market in Hong Kong has been traditionally anchored by stock, bond, gold, commodity, derivatives, or sub-market, and there are great potential to develop further. In 2017, the bond connect started that opened up the FIC market and opened up a new chapter.
subtitles.zh: 其次，支持香港多元化金融市场。香港传统以股票、债券、黄金等为主，潜力巨大。2017年债券通启动，开启了固定收益市场新篇章。

subtitles.en: I was the deputy governor of the PBOC at that time, Chen Derling. Mr. Chen Derling was the director of Hong Kong MA. We joined together and hit the drum about the ring to mark the beginning.
subtitles.zh: 我当时是人民银行副行长，与香港金管局总裁一起敲锣开市。

subtitles.en: In the past 10 years, the high quality bond insurance in Hong Kong has been growing up. A lot of the sovereignty issues, the sustainable bond in Hong Kong, that supports the directive markets development and other related products. Inflation and interest rate are not stable, Chinese bond sovereignty bond is stable. This is the feature of Chinese bond and it shows the comparative strengths and it attracts the international investors.
subtitles.zh: 过去十年，香港优质债券发行增长，主权债、可持续债券支持市场发展。通胀和利率不稳定，但中国主权债券稳定，这一特征吸引国际投资者。
en_highlights: Chinese bond sovereignty bond is stable

subtitles.en: RMB financing cost is relatively low that offers the opportunity for Hong Kong. Hong Kong should seize this opportunity and attract international investors to come to Hong Kong and get finance here. Hong Kong will then develop as the major financing hub.
subtitles.zh: 人民币融资成本较低，香港应抓住机遇，吸引国际投资者来港融资，发展成为主要融资枢纽。

title_lines: 中国人民银行副行长陈

subtitles.en: In the next stage, PBOC will work closely with the demand of the market, make Hong Kong more diversified. Hong Kong will be an international hub of the asset management and wealth management. First, Hong Kong will issue the offshore RMB future. For soon, Hong Kong will issue 5-year RMB futures. That offers a unique risk-atch.
subtitles.zh: 下一阶段，人民银行将贴近市场需求，推动香港多元化，成为国际资产和财富管理中心。香港将推出离岸人民币期货，很快将发行5年期人民币期货，提供独特风险对冲工具。

subtitles.en: Second, Hong Kong will develop a comprehensive trading platform of foreign currencies. PBOC is working with the FIC and Hong Kong M&A to upload the bond connect to be a platform. That will be a crucial contribution to the infrastructure. It offers the infrastructure service to use foreign reserves exchanges and bond exchanges. The collateral products will be expanded.
subtitles.zh: 第二，香港将发展综合外汇交易平台。人民银行正与金管局等升级债券通为平台，提供外汇和债券交易基础设施，并扩大抵押品范围。

subtitles.en: Therefore, Hong Kong's gold market will be developed further. The gold market of Hong Kong and the mainland China will be connected further. Just now, the CE announced the outline of the gold market development in Hong Kong. PBOC will be actively support Hong Kong's initiative. In the first stage, PBOC got the Shanghai gold exchange to set up the first warehouse of the transaction in Hong Kong.
subtitles.zh: 因此，香港黄金市场将进一步发展，与内地市场互联互通。行政长官刚宣布了香港黄金市场发展大纲，人民银行将积极支持，已推动上海黄金交易所在港设立首个交割仓库。

subtitles.en: I think the second quarter results kind of come out late July that's one of the real test.
subtitles.zh: 我认为二季度业绩在7月底出炉，那才是真正的考验。

subtitles.en: But if you look at the Samsung results, I mean the great results but look at the net margins.
subtitles.zh: 但看看三星的业绩，虽然很好，但看净利率。

subtitles.en: I mean high nigs and micron are like you know they grow net margins over 60 percent.
subtitles.zh: 像英伟达和美光，净利率超过60%。

subtitles.en: If you look at LV or even Apple their net margins around 20, this is three times of a consumer name.
subtitles.zh: 而LV甚至苹果的净利率只有20%左右，这是消费类公司的三倍。

subtitles.en: It's just not normal that will create a lot of imbalances within the AI ecosystem.
subtitles.zh: 这很不正常，会在AI生态中造成大量失衡。

subtitles.en: AI probably is the way with the future but we need to look at how much it cost when you run the AI business.
subtitles.zh: AI或许是未来方向，但我们需要看运行AI业务的成本。

subtitles.en: When you have increasing impact from hyperscalers most of the incremental expenditure going to the cost rather than the compute capacity, that alarm bell to me.
subtitles.zh: 当超大规模企业的影响增加，大部分增量支出流向成本而非算力，这对我来说是警钟。

subtitles.en: So 60 percent north of 60 percent net margin it's just not sustainable and healthy.
subtitles.zh: 所以60%以上的净利率是不可持续也不健康的。

subtitles.en: I mean we saw Apple raising prices of some of their products already right.
subtitles.zh: 我们看到苹果已经提高了部分产品价格。

subtitles.en: So you're basically saying demand destruction will happen pretty soon.
subtitles.zh: 所以你是在说需求破坏很快就会发生。

subtitles.en: It's already happening but it's going to be very visible in the next three to six months.
subtitles.zh: 已经发生了，但在未来3到6个月会非常明显。

subtitles.en: Talk to us as well about what looks good on the AI chain if we are looking a bit more near term before we see the wobbles.
subtitles.zh: 也谈谈在AI链条上，在波动出现前，短期什么看起来不错？

subtitles.en: We are value investors I tend to look at valuations a lot more than forecast of earnings because there's a highly uncertain sometimes.
subtitles.zh: 我们是价值投资者，我更看重估值而非盈利预测，因为后者高度不确定。

subtitles.en: If you look at in terms of PBs right I mean I think memory business is a cyclical business although everybody's saying today is not I doubt seriously doubt that's the case.
subtitles.zh: 从市净率看，存储业务是周期性的，尽管现在大家都说不是，我严重怀疑。

subtitles.en: In terms of PE memory stocks are very cheap but in terms of PB they're very expensive they're like four standard deviation above historical.
subtitles.zh: 从市盈率看存储很便宜，但从市净率看非常贵，比历史均值高出四个标准差。

subtitles.en: Even higher on the country you have company like Tencent it's in a 12 times earnings.
subtitles.zh: 甚至更高，而像腾讯这样的公司只有12倍市盈率。

subtitles.en: That cash flow to me is very much I can't say it's certain about with a hard degree of certainty with a 12 times earnings I find value in that kind of business.
subtitles.zh: 其现金流，我不能说完全确定，但12倍市盈率下，我在这种业务中看到了价值。

subtitles.en: Rather than paying you know something way into the future you see some correction in the Asia tax stocks today because they are kind of all beta play nowadays.
subtitles.zh: 而不是为遥远的未来买单。今天亚洲科技股回调，因为它们现在都是贝塔博弈。

subtitles.en: You've seen a 10% moving up and down in a day seem to be normal that cannot be normal as we know.
subtitles.zh: 一天涨跌10%似乎成了常态，这不正常。

subtitles.en: I've been doing this for 30 years that's just not normal so I feel there's a you know they have a reckoning it's upon us.
subtitles.zh: 我做了30年，这根本不正常，所以我觉得清算就在眼前。

subtitles.en: You said software in the US looks cheap right now I mean before this there was all this kind of concerns about disruption right.
subtitles.zh: 你说美国软件现在看起来便宜，之前大家都担心颠覆。

subtitles.en: I think if they make a proper transition using AI tools for their software business and used by the customers the corporations I think will be great business.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有特朗普/美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
